description: Append existing ring speed and amount controls after the unchanged 28-lane prefix. All earlier capability and numerical contracts remain unchanged.

host_automation_ring.keys: Original 28 in original order, then P_ringSpeed and P_ringAmount.
host_automation_ring.authority: Global ring speed and amount retain existing PANEL/factory/MEMORY independence. Ring depth, attack, decay and envelope behavior are outside this extension.
host_automation_ring.timing: Modern VST3 normalized interpolation through existing physical conversion and DSP. No-queue and Legacy/PURE final-point behavior unchanged. AU not expanded.
host_automation_ring.verification: Bounded actual-module Linux float32 checks with supported finite queues and explicitly recorded voice capacity, active-note and source-selection scope. Existing numeric tolerances unchanged. Exact runtime provenance and frozen pre-feature compatibility captures required; no malformed inputs, GUI, DAW, hardware or CPU claim.
